instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and back against the bench.
2. Press your palms hard against the flat sides of a weight plate at chest level, fingers pointing up.
3. Squeeze the plate and press it straight out until your arms are fully extended.
4. Keep squeezing the plate throughout to maximise chest tension.
5. Bring the plate back to your chest under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press through your chest, not your shoulders.
2. Squeeze the plate hard the whole time to keep the chest loaded.
3. Keep your back flat against the bench.
4. Breathe out as you press, in as you return.
name: Svend press flat bench

instructions:
1. Lie on an incline bench set to about 30 degrees with your back against the bench.
2. Press your palms hard against the flat sides of a weight plate at chest level, fingers pointing up.
3. Squeeze the plate and press it straight out until your arms are fully extended.
4. Keep squeezing the plate throughout to maximise upper chest tension.
5. Bring the plate back to your chest under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press through your upper chest, not your shoulders.
2. Squeeze the plate hard the whole time to keep the chest loaded.
3. Keep the angle near 30 degrees to bias the upper chest.
4. Breathe out as you press, in as you return.
name: Svend press incline bench

instructions:
1. Stand in the centre of a trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend your hips and knees and grip the handles with a neutral grip.
3. Brace your core, keep your chest up and back flat.
4. Push through your heels and drive up, extending hips and knees together.
5. Stand tall, then lower the bar to the floor under control by bending hips and knees.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and chest up throughout.
2. Push the floor away through your heels.
3. Keep the bar handles in line with your mid-foot.
4. Brace your core before each rep.
name: Trap bar deadlift

instructions:
1. Stand in the centre of a trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend your hips and knees and grip the handles with a neutral grip.
3. Stand tall with the bar at arm's length, core braced and back flat.
4. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears and squeeze at the top.
5. Lower your shoulders back down under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Shrug straight up, do not roll your shoulders.
2. Squeeze your traps at the top for a moment.
3. Keep your neck relaxed and your arms straight.
4. Breathe out as you shrug up, in as you lower.
name: Trap bar shrug

instructions:
1. Set the cable to a low position and grip the handle in one hand.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat and knees slightly bent.
3. Pin your upper arm against your side with the elbow bent at 90 degrees.
4. Straighten the elbow to extend your arm fully behind you, keeping the upper arm still.
5. Lower under control back to the bent position, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move only at the elbow; keep the upper arm locked in place.
2. Squeeze the triceps hard at full extension.
3. Keep your core braced to stop the torso swinging.
4. Use a light weight to keep the motion strict.
name: Tricep cable kickback on crossover machine
